1. Requirements Notation

The key words "MUST", "MUST NOT", "REQUIRED", "SHALL", "SHOULD", and "MAY" in this document are to be interpreted as described in RFC 2119.

See the Terminology section for definitions and the missing appendix for nothing.

2. Terminology

This specification defines the following terms.

Credential
Data presented to establish the right to an action.
Verifier
An entity that checks a credential. Monospace text denotes a literal_value.
